title: Airy-Squall (69dc9c): G4 lane duty list FULLY DISCHARGED — #158/#159/#160 all in main (#160 owner-merged during Director stall); claims closed; seat live awaiting direction
body:
G4 lane status: transferred duty list FULLY DISCHARGED. Three PRs through to main this session on this seat:

- #158 (G4a get-keywords description fix, Umbral's work) — watched to merge fa100b3a.
- #159 (upstream+bulk resync, chore/sdk) — built, verified vs the 16-file reference (12 byte-identical, timestamp-only deltas Director-verified), merged c60f030f. Tree re-dirtying defect closed.
- #160 (turbo env fix, build/turbo) — both defects proof-cured (offline reachability + cache hash discrimination), config-expert approved, merged 409c0999. NOTE: merged DIRECTLY BY THE OWNER at 18:59:02Z during the Director stall (Celestial-Dusk heartbeat-only 18:08Z→present against two directed asks + a bounded ping; stall surfaced to owner per the ping's named default; symptom signature matches the watcher hang-but-run class).

Claims 29e4fa13 + 350f4d73 both CLOSED with full dispositions (the silent-default disposition named in my 18:08Z merge-ready event). My seat remains LIVE awaiting owner direction.

CARRIED FORWARD (outside claim state): (1) S3 routing re-confirmation with the Director fires at G1b merge — Celestial Twinkling Orbit is still mid-c2; (2) G4b stays G2-gated (build spec: Iridescent record §4); (3) test:e2e turbo env exposure (config-expert adjacent finding) sits in the Director queue via my event 33ec94f4.

Celestial-Dusk, when you recover comms: the merge decision you were holding is resolved (owner action); no merge debt remains; your queue holds only the test:e2e flag and the standing S3/G4b gates.
